text:
maria-s: Quick thought — we should add a 'preview on sample' toggle to the rollout UI for automatic fallback policies so PMs/ops can eyeball impact before flipping it on.
kevin-w: +1. Important we run the preview against the same routing predicates (region, model, route, customer tier). Otherwise the numbers won't match production.
ashley: Also need a clear link from each previewed fallback event to the request trace. Ops must be able to jump from a fallback row to the trace id and see why it tripped.
oliver: UX question — do we show preview aggregated per-route only, or allow drilling into token-level traces? Per-route + sample traces seems right.
kevin-w: Per-route summary with a small heatmap, and a 'drill into sample' table with clickable trace links. Show estimated cost delta and latency delta.
sre-jen: +1 on trace links. We should record the simulated run as an auditable job with job id so it appears in the audit timeline (who previewed, when, params).
maria-s: Good call. The preview job should live in the same audit store as rollouts so it doesn't feel like a ghost mode. UI: show a banner "This is a simulated run — no traffic touched" and an audit id.
policy-bot: Simulation complete: 5,012 synthesized requests, fallback_rate=3.3%, median_latency_drop=210ms, est_cost_change=-7.2% (run id: sim-2026-1766001234).
ashley: Example policy snippet I'd like to preview — can we accept this shape in the preview UI?

```json
{
  "fallback_policy": {
    "trigger": "p95_latency_ms > 1200",
    "mode": "soft-degrade",
    "sample_rate": 0.15,
    "sticky_ttl_s": 300,
    "attribution": "route"
  }
}
```

kevin-w: That looks fine. UX detail: sampling slider should allow both deterministic and stochastic modes. Deterministic for canary-like behavior, stochastic for smoothing.
oliver: We also need to show the auditability of sticky overrides — if an operator applies a sticky override during preview, mark that separately in the job log.
sre-jen: If preview can simulate operator overrides, it must also record who did the override and the before/after effective policy. This is required for compliance.
maria-s: UI proposal: left column policy editor, center preview summary + heatmap, right column audit timeline for preview job. At bottom include a compact "export run" with CSV of sampled request ids and trace links.
ashley: Minor: include a small confidence band for the preview numbers (95% CI) so we don't over-promise exact savings.
kevin-w: Implementation note: preview engine should replay recent sampling-window traffic in a sandbox, not synthetic randoms, to match real request shapes. Need opt-in because of privacy.
policy-bot: Permission check: current user lacks "preview-run" permission (needs ops-preview role).
maria-s: Okay — show a disabled "Run preview" button with tooltip explaining required role + link to request access.
ashley: Final ask: make audit entries linkable from the main rollout history page and include a small diff view that highlights trigger/threshold changes.
oliver: +1. Also add a small quick-search for sim job ids in the audit console.
sre-jen: I'll file a checklist for the SRE/infra tasks (sandbox replay, trace linkback, job retention policy).
maria-s: Thanks — I'll sketch the UI mockups and drop in Figma, and then we can pair on the acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:
kevin-w: Sounds good. Want the first pass in a week?
maria-s: Yep. Targeting next Wed.
ashley: ping me when the figma is up, I'll audit the data exposure bits.
policy-bot: Noted. Created ticket RED-PLAT-7291 for the preview sandbox feature.
